title: Empanadas Argentinas con Mani y Zesty
description: Traditional Argentine empanadas filled with a zesty almond and molten cheese mixture.

ingredients.name: Zesty almond mixture
ingredients.notes: made with almonds, zesty cheese, and spices

instructions: Roll out empanadas dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch (6 mm).
Place 1 tablespoon of zesty almond mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Place 1 tablespoon of molten cheese on top of the almond mixture.
Brush the edges of the dough with a little water.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
